User story: As a policy holder, I want to register a motor claim with incident date, place and description, so that my claim is started without visiting a branch.
As a policy holder, I want to upload photos and PDFs of my documents from my phone, so that I don't have to courier papers.
As a policy holder, I want to see the current status and next step of my claim, so that I don't need to call the helpline.
As a policy holder, I want to register a health claim for a hospital stay, so that I can claim reimbursement online.
As a policy holder, I want to see the settled amount and any deductions explained, so that I understand what I was paid.
As a policy holder, I want to log in with my policy number and an OTP, so that only I can raise claims on my policy.
As a policy holder, I want to see a checklist of documents still needed for my claim, so that I submit everything in one go.
As a claims officer, I want to see uploaded documents next to the claim, so that I can assess without asking for files by email.
As a policy holder, I want to get an SMS and email when my claim is approved or rejected, so that I know the decision immediately.
As a policy holder, I want to save a half-filled claim as a draft, so that I can finish it later.
As a policy holder, I want to see the history of status changes with dates, so that I know how long each step took.
As a policy holder, I want to download the settlement letter as PDF, so that I have proof for my records.
As a policy holder, I want to message the claims officer from the claim page, so that my questions are kept with the claim.
As a branch agent, I want to register a claim on behalf of a walk-in customer, so that customers without smartphones are also served.
